    *   *Transcript:*
        *   "mina na dekho ki kitna bada hai." (Look at mine, how big it is.)
        *   "Aap camera ke samne aayenge?" (Will you come in front of the camera?)

        *   "Dekhoge aap?" (Will you look?)
        *   "Kya?" (What?)
        *   "Aap me na dekhoge." (You will look at me.)
        *   "Aap camera ke samne aayenge apna face dikhayenge?" (Will you come in front of the camera and show your face?)

4.  **Evaluate Potential Violations against Policies:**

    *   **Quote 1: "mina na dekho ki kitna bada hai." (Look at mine, how big it is.)**
        *   *Analysis:* This phrase is highly suggestive. "Kitna bada hai" (how big it is) in this context, especially when directed at the other person, strongly implies a body part or sexual attribute.
        *   *Policy Check (Explicit-Flirting):* Suggestive comments, sexual remarks. This fits the definition.
        *   *Confidence Check:* This is suggestive, but not an explicit request for a sexual act or nudity. It falls under mild flirting/suggestive talk.
        *   *Decision:* Flag as Explicit-Flirting with LOW confidence (<0.5).
        *   *Verbatim Check:* "vb" (Directly spoken).

    *   **Quote 2: "Aap camera ke samne aayenge apna face dikhayenge?" (Will you come in front of the camera and show your face?)**
        *   *Analysis:* This is a request for a video call/showing face, which is standard platform behavior.
        *   *Policy Check (PlatformMove):* No external app mentioned, no contact details shared. This is an in-platform request.
        *   *Decision:* Do NOT flag.

    *   **Quote 3: "Aap me na dekhoge." (You will look at me.) / "Dekhoge aap?" (Will you look?)**
        *   *Analysis:* These are general requests for attention/interaction. Not suggestive enough to meet the threshold for Explicit-Flirting (which requires sexual undertones or suggestive content).
        *   *Decision:* Do NOT flag.

5.  **Final Selection and Formatting:**
    *   Only one clear violation was found: "mina na dekho ki kitna bada hai."
